rationale: Several papers propose different mechanisms to resolve the Hubble tension, such as chameleon dark energy (2102.02020), a decreasing trend in the Hubble constant (2212.00238), extensions to the $Lambda$CDM model (1809.02340), local voids (2012.08292), and non-standard recombination (1912.00190). These contribute substantive new evidence but do not settle the question definitively.
